result.instructions: Tools for SalesDrive, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the orders placed today and their status."; "Which orders are still in progress, and who is the manager on each?"; "Move order 42957 to the status that means shipped.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SalesDrive data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run salesdrive_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run salesdrive_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run salesdrive_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. salesdrive_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: salesdrive_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (заявки) with their status, contact, products, delivery and payment fields. Filter by status, order number range, change date, order date or organization. At most 100 per page. SalesDrive API: GET /api/order/list/.

status_ids.description: Status ids, or __NOTDELETED__ (default: all except deleted) or __ALL__.

updated_from.description: Order changed on or after this time.

updated_to.description: Order changed on or before this time.

order_time_from.description: Order placed on or after this time.

order_time_to.description: Order placed on or before this time.

tools.name: salesdrive_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by its order number. Returns the order object, or a message when no order has that number. SalesDrive API: GET /api/order/list/ with filter[id].

tools.name: salesdrive_list_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: List the order statuses of the account with their ids and type (1 in progress, 2 sale, 3 unsuccessful, 4 deleted). Use the ids in salesdrive_update_order. SalesDrive API: GET /api/statuses/.

tools.name: salesdrive_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: List the payment methods of the account with their ids. SalesDrive API: GET /api/payment-methods/.

tools.name: salesdrive_list_delivery_methods
tools.title: List delivery methods
tools.description: List the delivery methods of the account with their ids. SalesDrive API: GET /api/delivery-methods/.

tools.name: salesdrive_find_contact_by_phone
tools.title: Find a contact by phone
tools.description: Find the client and the responsible manager for a phone number. Returns the manager (name, internal number) and the client record, if one matches. SalesDrive API: GET /api/get_manager_by_phone_number/.

tools.name: salesdrive_update_order
tools.title: Update an order
tools.description: Update an order's fields, for example statusId (order status), salesdrive_manager (responsible manager), comment, or paymentDate. Give order_id or external_id. Sends only the fields you pass. The API cannot change the city, branch or address of a Nova Poshta or Ukrposhta delivery. SalesDrive API: POST /api/order/update/.

order_id.description: SalesDrive order number. Use this or external_id.

external_id.description: Your own order number. Ignored when order_id is given.

data.description: Fields to set, for example { statusId: 1065 }. Use salesdrive_list_statuses for status ids.

tools.name: salesdrive_add_order_note
tools.title: Add a note to an order
tools.description: Add a note to an order's client communications block. The note gets the current time. Each call adds a new note. SalesDrive API: POST /api/order/note/.

annotations.title: Add a note to an order
